claims.text: Renal colic: paracetamol (acetaminophen) and NSAIDs relieve pain better than opioids; first-line after ruling out CIs.
claims.quote: Paracetamol and non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) can prove to be very effective in this instance and provide better pain relief than opioids; hence, they should be used as a first-line drug after ruling out contraindications
